'''Vinda'a BioChemical Laboratories''' was a biochemical research company.<ref name="SWG:STGZU">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Save Tatooine's G. Zocolidae Amedus!}}</ref>

As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] researchers of Vinda'a were doing an ongoing study of the local population of the microscopic [[Worm/Legends|worm]] [[G. Zocolidae Amedus]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The company hoped to find commercial applications for the worm's biological chemistry that could help removed toxic chemicals from a planet's soil. When the presence of local creatures threatened to disrupt the collection of these rare and valuable worms, the company hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill the creatures.<ref name="SWG:STGZU" />
